integrity: All definitions, proof, analytic restrictions, reproducibility instructions and finite verification code are self-contained in the accompanying package. The finite tests are not used to infer any infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the equal-weight eight-digit, ratio-one-third planar carpet, real-frequency zero geometry, and Taylor orders only at isolated zeros. It does not classify intersections among continuous nodal ovals, weighted carpets, or zeros at complex frequencies. Publication priority is not independently certified.
title: Isolated Fourier zeros and ternary multiplicity strata of the uniform Sierpiński carpet measure
